steps.label: Historical completed-task series by returned bucket

time.value: Current Dashboard panels are observed for the applied reporting period; a yesterday or last-week comparison requires the same metric, population, time basis and comparable explicit periods.

grain.value: One current Dashboard view per selected department/role variant and applied date filter; each panel keeps its own population and time basis.

caveats.value: A yesterday or last-week comparison requires the same metric, population, time basis and comparable explicit periods; where no matching historical series exists for an indicator, its change cannot be determined.

The Dashboard APIs return current summaries and a completed-task trend per actual bucket; they do not return yesterday values for every KPI, and weekly or monthly buckets must not be forced into daily values.
Each Dashboard panel has its own population and time basis; counts from different panels are not added together, and unavailable panels stay explicitly unavailable.

population.value: Current authenticated Dashboard workspace panels: My Tasks category counts, Service Application and Profile Verification summary cards, License Distribution, and My/Team Performance where observed.

filterScope.value: Dashboard panels are read under the selected department/role variant and applied date filter; panels are not merged into one record collection.
